seed.title: A capture that is never rewritten

reason: Seed 3 has the clearest facts of anything available, it is the seed marked best for Substack, and it already sits close to the question pasted under last week's piece.
you_add: Was there a moment, or an earlier version, when the agent did touch the capture, and what did that look like?
Why do your own words have to stay yours, in your terms, not the general case?
What do you do in practice with the comparison between the capture and what the agent produced, if anything?
What is it like to read a draft with those gaps in it, and how do you tell which parts are still you?
LinkedIn: one sentence on why this mattered to you as the builder.
X: one line on why your words stay untouched.
